=== DOCS-TRUTH (consolidated) ===
• dbt contracts enforce COLUMN NAMES + DATA TYPES + NOT NULL at BUILD TIME (dbt-core preflight in compilation, before any SQL hits the warehouse). On Trino + Iceberg via dbt-trino, only the `not_null` CONSTRAINT translates to a DB-enforced column DDL (`NOT NULL`, rejected at commit). `primary_key` / `foreign_key` / `unique` / `check` constraints CAN be declared in the YAML contract `constraints:` list but are NOT enforced by Trino + Iceberg at the database level — pair with dbt tests (`unique`, `relationships`, `dbt_utils.expression_is_true`) for the runtime check. Sources: docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-configs/contract; docs.getdbt.com/docs/collaborate/govern/model-contracts; docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-properties/constraints; docs.getdbt.com/reference/resource-configs/trino-configs (`only constraints with type as not_null are supported`).
• dbt exposures = exposures.yml with name / type / owner / depends_on: [ref('model_name')]; rendered into the dbt-docs site lineage DAG by `dbt docs generate` + `dbt docs serve`. Source: docs.getdbt.com/docs/build/exposures + cmd-docs.
• dbt macros: Jinja-templated SQL snippets defined as `{% macro name(args) %} ... {% endmacro %}` in the `macros/` directory of a dbt project; invoked at compile time via `{{ macro_name(args) }}` which performs TEXTUAL SQL SUBSTITUTION (NOT a runtime function call — stateless, no overloading). dbt_utils is an installable package of canonical macros (e.g., `generate_surrogate_key`, `expression_is_true`, `not_null_proportion`, `unique_combination_of_columns`, `relationships`). Source: docs.getdbt.com/docs/build/jinja-macros + github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-utils.
• Storage tiering on the Trino 467 + Iceberg 1.5.2 + MinIO stack is NOT a Trino-native feature. Tiering = MinIO object-lifecycle (`mc ilm tier add` + `mc ilm rule add --transition-days N --transition-tier <TIER_NAME>` scoped to `data/` prefix, keeping `metadata/` on hot) + Iceberg-retention (`expire_snapshots` to release tiered files from snapshot pinning). Trino has NO `SET STORAGE TIER`, NO `WITH (storage_tier=...)`, NO `iceberg.storage-tier.*` catalog property; EXPLAIN does NOT surface tier choice. Sources: trino.io/docs/current/connector/iceberg.html; docs.min.io/enterprise/aistor-object-store/administration/object-lifecycle-management/.
